newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt Bank gets two loans.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt Bank gets two loans.

text.p: Poland's Kredyt Bank SA received a 50 million zloty 37-month subordinated loan from Bank Slaski SA and a 20 million mark 12-month consortium loan, Kredyt Bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
Kredyt Bank said Germany's Landesbank Hessen-Thuringen Girozentrale was the leader of the consortium which lent it 20 million marks.
The bank did not give any other details and no one at Kredyt Bank was immediately available for comment.
Kredyt had earlier said it was seeking about 100 million zlotys in subordinated loans to effect its merger with Polish Investment Bank (PBI), which could be completed by year-end.
Last month a Polish state-owned bank PKO BP granted Kredyt Bank credit worth 60 million zlotys for a period of 42 months.
